_why: Everything a member's version changes. Times are SOURCE seconds. focus_y = where in the clip (0 top, 1 bottom) the crop window sits, so the face fills the half and stays clear of the labels.
_note: Example values: file names, keep ranges, speeds, focus_y and the labels only show the shape. YES = the dream (top half), BUT = the catch (bottom half). label = one or two words in caps with a colon; sub = 1-2 short lines. Make both clips the same length after speed (slow the shorter one or trim the longer). but_delay = seconds before BUT lands (0 = both labels from frame 0).
